id: title:Gilbert09:chunk checkout com payment searches to avoid 422s

review.posthog_relevance: Checks payment ingestion and retrieval against Checkout.com API constraints, potentially preventing 422 errors and request failures when fetching historical transaction data.
review.reason: Adds a 90-day search window constant and bounded iteration chunks to respect Checkout.com API documentation, replacing a potentially failing single-window retrieval with a chunked approach. This could prevent API request failures and 422 errors when fetching payment data.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the previous implementation exceeded the 90-day limit and caused failures; the code implements the safeguard but does not independently verify that the previous implementation was unsafe or that failures occurred. No tests or error handling are shown. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.
